answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 9 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in mirror, checked in haven, and fable shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 2578 identities would post 944 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
